meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把访谈或播客视频叠加动态字卡与图文框,直接产出可发布成片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有一段访谈或播客录像,想快速加上设计好的动态字卡和图文框再发布。
copy.tagline_en: Overlay timed graphic cards and lower-thirds on your podcast or interview video.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have an interview video needing timed graphic overlays before publishing.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会给已有的口播、访谈或播客视频设计与字幕时间同步的图形卡片(标题、下三分之一、数据标注、引用等),视频本身原样播放,最后渲染成 MP4。
howto.when: 当你说“graphic overlays”“on-screen graphics”或要求给视频做图形包装时触发;纯字幕需求走 embedded-captions,意图不明先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这条口播视频用图形卡片包装一下
say.note: 会先转写,再规划卡片时间轴

say.text: 这段访谈做成 9:16 竖版,加下三分之一和画中画
say.note: 画布比例和布局在第 7 步确认

say.text: 给这段播客加上与字幕同步的数据标注卡片
say.note: 卡片按字幕时间点对齐

howto.what_en: Claude designs timed graphic cards (titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes) synced to the transcript of an existing talking-head, interview or podcast clip on a 16:9/9:16/4:5 canvas, then renders it to MP4. The clip plays untouched.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", or ask to package / dress up a video. Plain subtitles go to /embedded-captions; unclear intent goes to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Package this talking-head video with graphic cards
say_en.note: Transcribes first, then plans card timing

say_en.text: Make this interview a 9:16 cut with lower-thirds and PiP
say_en.note: Canvas and layout are confirmed at Step 7

say_en.text: Overlay transcript-synced data callout cards on this podcast
